recentItems.title: Jai Hanuman (Lyrical Video) | Hanuman Ansh Movie Song | Shreyas Dharmadhikari | Neem Karoli Baba
recentItems.description:
Times Music presents 'Jai Hanuman' from the blockbuster film 'Hanuman Ansh', sung and composed by Shreyas Dharmadhikari. This powerful Hanuman Ansh song celebrates the strength, courage, and unwavering devotion of Bajrangbali, with verses inspired by the Bhimrupi Maruti Stotra.

Follow the words of the song in this lyrical video as it brings alive the devotion of Ramdoot, Anjani Sut, and Sankat Haran. Play this Hanuman bhajan for Tuesday prayers, Hanuman pooja, temple worship, and moments of devotion.

recentItems.title: Ganpati Full Power | Piyush Kapoor | New Ganpati Song 2026 | Ganesh Chaturthi | Ganpati Visarjan
recentItems.description:
Feel the power of Bappa with ‘Ganpati Full Power’, a high-energy Ganpati song sung by Piyush Kapoor. Driven by powerful beats, dhols, and a larger-than-life festive music, this Ganesh song captures the intensity and devotion of Ganesh Utsav, making it perfect for Ganpati mandals, aagman, dance celebrations, and Visarjan.

Built for moments when the chants of Ganpati Bappa Morya fill the streets, ‘Ganpati Full Power’ brings together devotion and celebration in full force. Add this powerful Ganesha song to your festive playlist and celebrate Bappa with energy, faith, and music.

recentItems.title: Little Thomas Teaser | Gulshan Devaiah, Rasika Duggal, Hridansh, Kaushal Oza | Releasing Oct 23
recentItems.description:
“WHERE DO BABIES COME FROM?” Little Thomas is seven years old, full of questions, and growing up in the Goa of the early '90s ☀️

Take this warm, funny and nostalgic ride with seven-year-old Thomas and his family through all of life's ups and downs and you’ll be reminded of the enduring charm of classics like  Malgudi Days and the stories of Ruskin Bond.

Watch this Anurag Kashyap backed children’s film ‘Little Thomas’, starring Rasika Dugal and Gulshan Devaiah, and directed by Kaushal Oza, releasing in cinemas on 23rd October!

Produced by Luminoso Pictures, Civic Studios, Good Bad Films, and Flip Films.

recentItems.title: Sach Ka Daayra | Meghna G | Kareena K K, Prithiviraj S | Gulzar, Amit T, B Praak | Daayra Sep 18
recentItems.description:
सच का एक नया पहलू। 
गुलज़ार साहब की आवाज़ में। 

“Sach Ka Daayra” unfolds as a reflection of the unease that lingers at the film’s events, echoing
the angst, helplessness, and unanswered questions left in their wake. The song binds these
emotions into a musical expression of the story. At its core, Sach Ka Daayra asks just one question:
When the truth changes with perspective, where does the boundary of justice truly lie?

recentItems.title: Aavagaman (Lyrical) | Hanuman Ansh | Movie Song | Sadhu Tiwari | Shobhinaw Satyaa | Har Har Mahadev
recentItems.description:
Times Music presents the lyrical video of 'Aavagaman', a Hanuman Ansh song sung by Sadhu Tiwari. A devotee's heartfelt prayer to Bhole Shankar, featuring the chants 'Har Har Mahadev' and 'Shiv Shambhu', Aavagaman seeks freedom from the endless cycle of birth and rebirth and prays for lasting surrender at his feet.

Based on the miraculous life of Neem Karoli Baba, 'Hanuman Ansh' has won hearts worldwide. Play this Shiv bhajan for daily Shiv pooja, Monday prayers, Sawan, temple worship, or moments of meditation. 

🙏 Har Har Mahadev!
